charts.title: TOI-776 c: orbits around TOI-776
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-776's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-776 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Kokori et al. 2023 (2023ApJS..265....4K), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname KOKORI_ET_AL__2023): P 15.66534 d

charts.title: TOI-776 c: its transit
charts.description: TOI-776 c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (90, 100, 101) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 306996324, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 12-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 12-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
